notes.title: Month 7: Demo out now! Metaprogression and Unlocks Overhaul
notes.content:
Going forward, updates are now going to go directly to the demo, its free to download from the steam page. Playtest is currently going to be close for the time being

Completely reworked metaprogresion and upgrades to provide more rewarding experiences for players.

Added a few initial languages German, Portuguese, Italian, Spanish, Czech, French

New ascension type mode.
in actual game will unlock next year after completing previous

Tavern - increase health of troops

ui game over panel fix, card overhaul, add season specific call early bonuses, fix scaling of relics on uw, weird building placement bug, need more expensive later buildings, chance to fix castle, expensive building to make spells more viable later rounds, Misc fixes for duplicate damage on troops, wave progress bar, rallypoints, rebalancing cloudstone costs, relics, fixing lin king, adding text to soverien mode, rallypoints, healthbars, goblin king texture, added leaves to fall, refresh beastiary

notes.title: Month 6 Week 1: Cards Overhaul, Save System, Tier 4 Magic and Artillery
notes.content:
[h1]Card Overhaul[/h1]
Rewrote card system to be much simpler and more streamlines
Redid most of the metaprogression with the cards
Rarity - Cards drawn based on Rarity
Card UI Polish

[h1]Save System[/h1]
Your game will now save on season end. Saves towers, stats, cards etc

[h1]Demo Balance[/h1]
Did quite a bit of balancing for tower costs and wave strength to make the first season playable for users. As I move to an open demo on the main game page that will have less content then the playtest and instead focus on a core polished experience.
Magic Tier 4 will be unlocked in demo

Tier 4 Magic and Artillery Towers Polished

[h1]Fixes and Polish[/h1]
Merchant polish
[list]
[*] fixed cards leaning thorough back
[*] fixed cards prices reappearing
[*] fixed shop reloading relics
[*] added voicelines
[/list]

Leveling up towers in save data
Labels incorrectly displaying building info
Harpy Health bar fix
New Dust Clouds for enemies jumping

New list of over 30 relics with unique mechanics, tried to replace any sort of boring number changes and instead make them more situational and interesting

Added new tier 4 towers for wizards, sorcerers, artificers, rangers, warlocks, paladins and rogues. Will continue to polish and add mechanics in the coming weeks.

notes.title: Month 5 Week 3: City Buildings Refresh and Seasons System
notes.content:
[h1]City Buildings:[/h1]
Refocused to keep design centered around tower defense, city buildings now play a more direct role. 
[b]Watchtower[/b] - Shows what enemies are approaching in next wave
[b]Lumbermill[/b] - Allows clearing of forests for placing buildings on quads
[b]Hunter Cottage[/b] - Produces food from neighboring forests
[b]Market Square[/b] - Increases Merchant likelihood of arrival

[h1]Seasons System[/h1]
Added skyboxes and floating islands 
New Lighting and coloring for buildings, trees, grass, rivers, skyboxes, farms, and floating rocks

[h3]Misc Fixes:[/h3]
Metaprogression Screen bug fixes
Fixed mmf package error that presented at beginning of game
Farm shape Fixes

[h1]Tier 4  Towers

notes.title: Month 4 Week 3 The City Builder Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Features:[/h1]

[h3]City Builder Basics[/h3]
New Tower Unlocking System 
Requires buildings instead of cards
Buildings need to be unlocked via metaprogression
[h3]Economy System[/h3]
Farms and Windmills
Farms grant +10 gold per turn
Windmills grant +5 gold per adjacent farm
Housing
produces gold if upkeep in food is paid
Quarry
must be placed on mine, produces gold

[h2]Bugs Resolved[/h2]

Can build structures inside castle
[Castle health does not get updated when modified by relics](https://github.com/Memori-Studios/CastlesOnClouds-Playtest/issues/24)

[Helm of the Forest King increases range by 1000% instead of 10%](https://github.com/Memori-Studios/CastlesOnClouds-Playtest/issues/23)

Did a major refactor of the camera pause and escape menu to now supersede everything (upgrades, shop, etc) so there maybe a bug or two I missed.

[Artificer shooting beyond its rang](https://github.com/Memori-Studios/CastlesOnClouds-Playtest/issues/20)e (Mage as well)

Can select multiple spells

Tooltips don't have slide animation when shown consecutively

Clouds get in the way of camera
Inconsistent naming of wizard tower upgrade cards

Implemented illusion items with with newly created humans
Refactored hand ik work with character creation over netcode
Refactored Doors to handle netcode in a much simpler, more efficient fashion

Reintegrated Office station to allow Decoration selections
Integrated netcode to display decoration selections made by another player
New mouse speed modifier allowing player to choose mouse speed, saved locally between sessions
New Lobby Screen to better fit match theme
New controls section added to settings window

Issues Fixed
Fixed first person camera rotation issues
Fix for interact with mugrack through wood pillar
Fix for x button not closing settings windows
Fix to exit seat by pressing [F] instead of [E]
Fixed tavern ceiling where player could see through in some spots
Fixed all scroll bars in character creation
